messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 1713002468 - INCIDENT detected: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings for customer Tidegate (enterprise) in us-west-2. Error rate ~6% over baseline. Paging on-call. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1713002468

emma_ops: Paging @raj_oncall — can you take primary?

raj_oncall: Ack. On it. Investigating now. Starting runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embeddings-5xx

raj_oncall: Quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep runtime-pool-3` -> 5 restarts in last 10m; OOM events present.

tom_engineering: I'm seeing repeated OOMs in runtime-pool-3 logs; batch queue length spiked at 12:28. Likely batching + memory pressure due to a larger-than-usual request.

raj_oncall: Doing immediate mitigation: scale runtime-pool-3 from 3 -> 6, set drain on pods with restarts, and enable model fallback routing for Tidegate (30%).

lia_cs: FYI AEs: Tidegate support just pinged the team. They'll expect an update. @nora_account_exec can you draft a short customer statement?

nora_account_exec: Draft for Tidegate (please edit): "We're investigating an issue causing increased errors for embedding requests in us-west-2 between ~12:25-12:40 PT. Some requests may have failed with 5xx. We're applying mitigations to restore service; no persisted data was impacted. Next update in 30 minutes or when resolved."

lia_cs: Suggest wording tweak: replace 'rolling a fix' with 'applying mitigations' and add 'we understand this impacts production inference for a subset of requests'.

nora_account_exec: Updated draft: "We're investigating an issue causing increased errors for embedding requests in us-west-2 between ~12:25-12:40 PT. Some production requests may have failed with 5xx. We're applying mitigations to restore service; no persisted data was impacted. We'll update you within 30 minutes or sooner."

raj_oncall: Mitigation applied: scaled pool, drained unstable pods, and routed 30% traffic to fallback model `v2-emb-small`. Error rate dropped to ~0.7% in the last 2 minutes.

emma_ops: Approve the customer note. Status page draft below — please sign off: 

```
Status: Partial outage - Embeddings (us-west-2)
Impact: Some enterprise customers (Tidegate) experienced increased 5xx errors for embedding requests.
Time window: 2026-03-16 19:25 UTC - ongoing
Mitigation: Traffic shifted to fallback model and capacity scaled; error rate has reduced.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when resolved.
```

raj_oncall: Publishing status update now.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/embeddings-usw2-1713002468

tom_engineering: Observed likely root cause: autoscaler threshold was using CPU% metric; should have been queue-length. Under-provisioning occurred during burst. Preparing RCA notes.

emma_ops: Schedule postmortem for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Invite eng-runtime, oncall, and cs.

lia_cs: Customer message sent via AE channel to Tidegate. Will escalate to execs if they request.

raj_oncall: Confirming resolution: monitoring shows stable error rate <1% for 10m and tail latency back to baseline. Keeping incident open for 30m watch.

incident-bot: Incident mitigation recorded. Resolved (mitigation): 1713002680 - error rate back to baseline. Logs archived: ops/incidents/1713002468

nora_account_exec: Follow-up email ready (contains timeline, impact, mitigations, next steps). Will send after RCA review.

emma_ops: Thanks team — great coordination. :thumbsup:"
